text:
The net yield of substrate-level phosphorylation in glycolysis is **2 ATP per glucose**. Four ATP are made (two at phosphoglycerate kinase, two at pyruvate kinase), and two are spent in the hexokinase and phosphofructokinase steps. The question is a little ambiguous, since "substrate-level phosphorylation" strictly produces 4 ATP before the investment is subtracted, but the net figure is 2.

CONFIDENCE: 95
